context_pill: PGBP Computation & Adjustments for Sankar Ltd.
example_summary: Sankar Ltd net profit computation under PGBP incorporating adjustments for Section 36(1)(iii), Section 40(a)(ia), Section 36(1)(va), and Section 80JJAA.
source_provision:
### Statutory Summary Matrix: PGBP Adjustments & Disallowances

| Section / Rule | Statutory Provision & Condition | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 36(1)(iii)** | Interest on capital borrowed for asset acquisition | Disallowed for the period from borrowing till asset is first put to use; added back to business income. |
| **Section 43B** | Statutory dues & employer contributions to welfare funds | Allowed as deduction if deposited on or before the due date of filing return under Section 139(1). |
| **Section 36(1)(va)** | Employee contributions to PF / EPF | Treated as income if not deposited on or before the due date under the respective Provident Fund Act. |
| **Section 40(a)(ia)** | Non-deduction of Tax at Source (TDS) on resident payments | 30 percent of any sum paid to a resident on which TDS was required is disallowed. |
| **Section 41(1)** | Remission or cessation of a trading liability | Taxable as business income if a benefit is obtained by way of remission or cessation. |


> [!IMPORTANT]
> Capitalization Rule: Under the proviso to Section 36(1)(iii), interest paid on borrowings specifically for acquiring a capital asset prior to its first use cannot be claimed as revenue expenditure.


> [!WARNING]
> TDS Default Consequence: Failure to deduct tax under Section 194C on labor charges results in a statutory disallowance of 30 percent of the relevant expenditure under Section 40(a)(ia).

director.justification: The provision mechanism requires a structured multi-step computation starting from net profit, applying additions and deductions across various sections like 36(1)(iii), 43B, 36(1)(va), 40(a)(ia), and 80JJAA to arrive at total income and tax liability for Sankar Ltd.
director.visual_metaphor: A multi-layered accounting waterfall descending from net profit to net taxable income through statutory adjustments.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish the starting net profit baseline for Sankar Ltd.
Apply interest disallowance under Section 36(1)(iii) proviso for pre-use period.
Disallow 30 percent of labor charges under Section 40(a)(ia) for TDS default on payment to A & Co.
Treat unremitted employee EPF contribution as income under Section 36(1)(va).
Deduct allowable wage revision provision and compute depreciation under Income-tax Rules.
Compute Chapter VI-A deduction under Section 80JJAA for additional employees.
Summarize total income, tax payable, surcharge, and cess for Sankar Ltd.
